description: One cold launch per process of a kernel whose loop body is body_ops straight-line dependent operations, executed loops times by a loop that is not unrolled; one kernel per body size and operation kind. Entry is: query the selected kernel's attributes to request that the runtime load it without running it (whether that fully pre-loads it is runtime-specific), optional clock/cache warmer, then the single timed launch, which is the kernel's first dispatch in the process. From times at several body_ops and loops, derive downstream the fixed dispatch cost, the repeat-pass cost per operation (time difference between two loops values divided by the extra operations; it rises when the body no longer fits an instruction-cache level) and the first-pass extra cost (what bringing the code in costs the first time), against the measured code bytes of each compiled kernel. The body's own execution time hides any refetch faster than the body consumes code, which is why the cheap xor_add body exists. The differences do not separate instruction fetch from address translation.

scaling_param.name: body_ops
scaling_param.description: Operations in the straight-line loop body; selects the kernel fetch_kernel_<body_ops> or fetch_xor_add_kernel_<body_ops> and with it the static code footprint

non_scaling_params.name: loops
non_scaling_params.description: Times the loop body is executed in the one timed launch; operations per thread = body_ops * loops, at most 1048576. 1 runs every operation once, on code not executed before; larger values add repeat passes over the same code

non_scaling_params.name: op
non_scaling_params.description: Body operation. fma: x = fmaf(x, a, b) on float, one instruction per operation. xor_add: x = (x ^ a) + b on unsigned, two cheap instructions per operation, so the body consumes code faster

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid; the declared sweep uses one block so a single SM/CU fetches the code

non_scaling_params.name: threads_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Number of threads per block; the declared value is one AMD wavefront

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the clock/cache warmer before the timed launch. It does not promise a particular cache or clock state.
